keyword: all in one ai video generator
title: Best All in One AI Video Generator Tools (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.modelSupport: Multi-model catalog across image, video and audio nodes

quickstart.label: Add the hosted MCP server to Claude Code, then approve the OAuth consent screen:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: In Claude Desktop or claude.ai, add the same URL as a custom connector. Read-only tools (`list_workflows`, `list_models`, `get_execution`) cost nothing; `run_workflow` is the only one that spends credits.

tools.name: Runway
tools.tagline: cloud creative suite built around its own Gen-4.5 model
tools.claudeConnection: First-party MCP server, run locally from Runway's own repo
tools.modelSupport: Runway's own model family plus third-party models, queryable at runtime

quickstart.label: The MCP server is not published to npm — clone and build it, then point your MCP config at `build/index.js`. Needs a Runway developer API key.
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/runwayml/runway-api-mcp-server
cd runway-api-mcp-server
npm install
npm run build

quickstart.label: The official SDKs cover the same API without MCP:
quickstart.code:
npm install @runwayml/sdk   # https://github.com/runwayml/sdk-node
pip install runwayml         # https://github.com/runwayml/sdk-python

tools.name: Canva
tools.tagline: design platform with Veo 3 clips inside its existing editor
tools.modelSupport: Canva’s own generative features inside the editor
tools.note: The public API is the Canva Connect API. Canva publishes an OpenAPI spec at https://www.canva.dev/sources/connect/api/latest/api.yml rather than a first-party client package.

quickstart.label: Quickstart copied verbatim from Canva’s Connect API docs:
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/canva-sdks/canva-connect-api-starter-kit.git
cd canva-connect-api-starter-kit
npm install

tools.note: Checked 2026-09-01: no public developer docs and no reachable pricing page URL — every pricing path tried returned 404, so nothing is linked rather than guessing one.

tools.tagline: browser editor with avatars, voice cloning and subtitles
tools.modelSupport: VEED’s own AI video, lip-sync and subtitle models

tools.name: Descript
tools.tagline: text-based editor that cuts video via the transcript
tools.claudeConnection: Descript documents a Claude/MCP integration alongside its CLI and HTTP API
tools.modelSupport: Descript’s own editing, transcription and voice models
tools.note: Descript states API access is included for all paying users at no extra cost, drawing on existing plan credits. Base URL https://descriptapi.com/v1, `Authorization: Bearer` auth.

quickstart.label: CLI install copied verbatim from Descript’s API docs:
quickstart.code:
npm install -g @descript/platform-cli@latest
descript-api config set api-key
